{{Quote|Doctor Lerek is gone. Good riddance.|Doctor Soprin|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Lerek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] working for [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] before the [[Great Galactic War]]. He was part of the team under [[Director/Legends|Director]] [[Antayen]] that worked on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] excavating [[The Imprisoned One's mind prison]]. While Doctor [[Soprin]] speculated that the device was a [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] creation, Lerek openly mocked the theory, which caused her to dislike him. Lerek insisted that the device was a dangerous weapon and fearing for his life eventually left the team. Before leaving Tatooine altogether, he stopped at the [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] and recorded one final message, warning not to tamper with the device. Unfortunately, Lerek's concerns have proven justified, as [[The Imprisoned One]] broke free and killed or enslaved all personnel present at Czerka base at the time.
